question: Will Putin accept the Oslo proposals, yes or no?

lines.text: US envoy Steve Witkoff has landed in St Petersburg for talks with Vladimir Putin.
He flew in from Oslo, where he met Volodymyr Zelensky on Tuesday.
Russian state media say Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev met him at the airport.
Norway's prime minister says Witkoff is carrying proposals from the Oslo talks.
lines.note: Jonas Gahr Store, via Kyiv Post

lines.text: Zelensky says they include several types of security guarantees, and Kyiv will wait for Putin's answer.
Before Oslo, Ukraine went a week without US intelligence warnings of Russian strikes.
Now Zelensky says that sharing is back.
His words: we are thankful that intelligence works now.

scene.quote: We are thankful that intelligence works now

lines.text: He expects results on Patriot missiles and Starlink within 48 hours.
Politico reports the US will offer Putin face to face talks with Trump and Zelensky.
Russia's foreign minister Sergei Lavrov says any plan should not involve political concessions from Moscow.

scene.quote: It should not involve any political concessions on our part

lines.text: The Kremlin says every meeting with Trump's envoys is very important and well timed.
Will Putin accept the Oslo proposals, yes or no?
